resources.string: Open Parent Center on the TV and scan the QR code shown there. The address is remembered, so you only scan once.
Can\'t scan? Enter the address manually
The phone and the TV must be on the same Wi-Fi network. This app opens the Parent Center page served by your TV; it has no account or cloud service of its own.
Enter the complete address from the TV\'s QR code: IP, port and the code after it.
The scanner could not start. Try again.
Allow camera access to scan the QR code on the TV.
Allow camera access in Settings to scan the TV QR code. You can still enter the address manually.
The saved address will be replaced. The Parent Center session on the TV is not affected.
